photos.c: Eighteen year old one-lap racer Michael Parper came back to the Belgrave Rankings with a vengeance, clocking 48.54 at Bedford in the AAA U20 Champs. One of four Belgravians ranked in the Junior UK Top 20 for the 400m event, Michael has been elected our Under 20 Men's Captain for 1997.
1997 saw Under 20 Michael Parper head the Belgrave Rankings over 400 metres - no mean feat!
